node.title: Rate-half MCA record-local common-core owner noninvariance
node.statement: Over RS[GF(11),GF(11)^*,5] at agreement 7, two non-global-affine critical order-six records share one support-wise MCA-bad slope but have different intersections of their maximal agreement supports, {8,10} and {10}. Every displayed slope has a unique degree-<5 explanation on its exact seven-point maximal support and fails same-support pair containment. Thus the record-local common core is not a slope invariant and cannot by itself define disjoint fixed-core ownership. This is a route cut below the deployed row, not a refutation of every chronology-correct whole-line selector.
